title: App Launch Checklist
tagline: Everything to check before you submit to the App Store and Google Play - free, no signup.
description: Free app launch checklist covering store listings, legal, testing and launch day - filter by iOS, Android or both so nothing slips before you submit.
intro:
Most apps do not get rejected or flop at launch because the code is bad - it is because something small got missed: a privacy policy that was never linked, a data safety form left blank, a support email that bounces, an icon in the wrong size. Every one of those is a five-minute fix if you catch it early, and a launch-day scramble if you do not.

This checklist pulls together the things that actually trip up first-time launches, grouped into the order you would tackle them: store listing, legal, accounts, testing, marketing and post-launch. Filter it to iOS, Android or both so you are only looking at what applies to you.

Everything runs in your browser. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored, and checking a box does not send anything anywhere - close the tab and it resets.
howTo: Pick iOS, Android or Both at the top so the list only shows what applies to your launch.
Work through each section in order - store listing and legal first, since store review checks those.
Check items off as you finish them; the progress bar and per-section counts update as you go.
Watch the "Still required" warning - it lists anything unchecked that stores actually reject apps for.
Use "Reset" to start a fresh pass, for example when you are prepping a second app.

faq.q: Is this list specific to Apple's App Store, Google Play, or both?
faq.a: Both, by default. Filter to iOS or Android at the top and items that only apply to the other platform - like Apple's Paid Apps agreement or Google Play's Data safety form - hide automatically. Items that apply to both platforms, like having a privacy policy, stay visible either way.

faq.q: What's the difference between "Required" and "Recommended" items?
faq.a: Required items are things a store review will actually reject your app for missing, or that block submission outright - a privacy policy link, a completed data safety form, a signed developer agreement. Recommended items are strongly worth doing but won't get you rejected on their own, like beta testing on TestFlight or having a landing page ready.

faq.q: Does checking items off save my progress?
faq.a: No, on purpose. Nothing here is uploaded or stored anywhere, which also means nothing persists - refresh the page or come back tomorrow and every box is unchecked again. Keep the tab open, or come back for a second read-through before you actually submit.

faq.q: I've launched apps before - is this overkill?
faq.a: Skip straight to the "Still required" warning box once you've checked everything you know you need - it only lists what's missing, so an experienced team can use it as a final pre-submission scan rather than a step-by-step guide.

faq.q: Why isn't there an item for app store optimization keywords?
faq.a: This checklist covers what blocks or trips up a launch, not the ongoing work of ranking well afterward. Keyword research gets one line item as a launch-week task; for the deeper work, that's its own project once the app is live.

faq.q: Is anything sent to a server?
faq.a: No. The whole thing is JavaScript running in your browser. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is saved, and closing the tab erases every checked box.
